Ford Otomotiv Sanayi AS Reports Steady Export Figures Amid Stable Market Conditions

Ford Otomotiv Sanayi AS, a leading player in Turkey's automotive sector, reported consistent trade activity in its latest monthly figures, reflecting ongoing stability in both domestic and export markets. The company disclosed that total vehicle exports for the previous month reached 24,600 units, closely aligning with volumes seen in the same period last year.

Revenue from exports rose modestly by 2.1%, buoyed by favorable exchange rates and steady demand from key European destinations. According to a statement from company spokesperson Emre Yıldız, “Our performance this month underscores the resilience of our supply chain and the continued appeal of our models in international markets. We remain focused on operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.”

Industry analysts noted that the Turkish automotive sector has maintained a stable trajectory in recent months, supported by gradual recovery in European demand and government incentives for local manufacturers. “Ford Otomotiv Sanayi AS’s figures are in line with broader industry trends,” observed Aylin Korkmaz, senior analyst at the Turkish Automotive Exporters Association. “While growth is modest, it reflects a healthy, functioning market without significant disruption.”

The company’s domestic sales also remained stable, with 7,500 units delivered to local dealers. Union representatives welcomed the figures, highlighting ongoing job security for plant workers in Kocaeli and Eskişehir. Haluk Demir, regional chair of the Automotive Workers Union, stated, “Stable production levels mean continued employment and confidence for our members.”

Ford Otomotiv Sanayi AS affirmed its commitment to ongoing investment in production capacity and technological innovation, positioning itself for continued growth in both local and international markets.
